- **Status:** Ready

- **Type:** data (thin slice; a measurement run)
- **Milestone:** Measure first: does Phrase beat plain C# on tokens and attempts at an equal or better pass rate?

The frozen bar is Decider D32 and is not changed by this card.

- **Story:** As Riley, I want the Phrase arm run on the eight development tasks at N=5 per model, cold, scored by executed outcomes, so that the two arms have rows at the same proof level before any comparison.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given N=5 scheduled runs for each included model on each of the eight tasks, When the run finishes, Then each row records pass, attempts, tokens in, tokens out (documentation tokens included and charged on every attempt, D32), kind, proof level specs-passed, cold, patched false, and label head2head-dev-rN (the check fails if any field is missing)
  2. Given the stored rows, When they are summarized, Then the summary shows pass rate, mean attempts and mean total tokens per model for write and for change tasks, beside the plain C# baseline numbers from card 094, and states no verdict (the verdict page is card 103)
  3. Given the sealed holdouts (hashes in bench/holdout-hashes.txt), When the run finishes, Then no holdout body was opened and no holdout row exists

## Context

- Only models that are available are included (agy is out of quota until about 2026-11-01); fewer than 3 models makes the later verdict INCONCLUSIVE by the frozen bar (D32).
- A compact cheat sheet is allowed only if it is committed and its hash recorded in a Decider BEFORE the first row of this card, and it is charged like any documentation (D66). The run is long and spends finite allotments: pace it and run it as a tracked background task.
- Pre-registered bar: Decider D32, not changed by this card; numbers inform and nothing is kept or reverted on results alone.
